detail.longDescription: I've always dreaded filling out the paperwork that comes with starting a new job: tax withholding, direct deposit forms, I-9s, benefits enrollment, the list goes on. But it's worth remembering that someone has to send, review, and process all of those documents for every single hire. And that only scratches the surface of what HR entails.
